answer: Genesis tax: each new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable 20 POA tax before acting, sunk, so capital cannot be recycled. After 30 clean epochs the rate falls to 2 POA, but fakes spread like a vine: each new shoot pays 20 POA again. 100 fakes cost 100 x 20 = 2,000 POA; one walnut is cheap, ten thousand empty the sack, while an honest agent pays 20 POA once. Tax floor is basalt: it cannot be haggled down, and honest earnings stay undiluted.
